title: ventures-tests.yml's path filter misses the modules its runner unit tests import, so a change to one goes untested until a venture PR
problem: ventures-tests.yml runs `python3 -m unittest test_run_venture_tests` (step 'Runner unit tests') only when ventures/**, run_venture_tests.py, its test or the workflow change. The test imports unwired_checks, inherited_keys, run_workflow_locally, pyenv and main_health too. #15891 (2026-11-14) renamed unwired_checks.run_all to run_everything; ventures-tests did not trigger, so the test that patched run_all went red on main unseen and the next venture PR (#15894) inherited the failure and had to fix it. main_health.py does not run platform/ci unit tests, so it stayed green (73/73). The edit is in .github/, which CODEOWNERS holds for the owner.
evidence: git show a6e0395db --stat (#15891): platform/ci/unwired_checks.py changed, no ventures/ path
git show db42abad7 (#15894), third commit: 'test_run_venture_tests: patch unwired_checks.run_everything (renamed from run_all in #15891, broke changed-ventures on main)'
local: transitive platform/ci imports of test_run_venture_tests.py (ast walk, 2026-11-14): inherited_keys, main_health, pyenv, run_venture_tests, run_workflow_locally, unwired_checks
change: Add platform/ci/{unwired_checks,inherited_keys,run_workflow_locally,pyenv,main_health}.py to both `paths:` lists of ventures-tests.yml. Longer term, a check that every workflow running a platform/ci unit test lists that test's local imports in its path filter would catch the next one.
metric: commits on main where test_run_venture_tests fails while the last ventures-tests run on main was green
